<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

pij refuses `pij docs` today, and a seat outside the pij repo cannot read `docs/how/`. Pages now live as markdown files in `docs/cli/` (page id = path without `.md`, so a later `types/knowledge` page is a file in `docs/cli/types/`). One table in a pure module, `crates/cli/src/docs.rs`, includes each file with `include_str!`, so the pages are fixed at build time with the version. The first page is the start page; the concepts and type pages follow in step s03 by adding files and table rows.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Any seat in any repo reads pij's start page and reference pages with one command.
- The pages a seat reads match the pij binary it runs.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- The concepts, type and pods pages (step s03) and the check that a bundled page equals its file (step s02).
- Refusals and first turns naming pages (step s04).
- Moving `docs/how/` into the CLI.

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

Verbs that own their grammar and help are clap subcommands with `disable_help_flag` and trailing args (`claim`, `directory`); the shim forwards the names in `harness/scripts/pij-native-verbs.json`, and `shim_forward_tests` (main.rs), `generation-routing.test.ts`, `generation-skill-coverage.test.ts` and `crates/cli/tests/skill_verb_coverage.rs` hold those lists, RS_ROUTE_TABLE and the skill's tables together. `main()` already handles `hook claude-display` before the runtime; the docs verbs go there too. The sibling ddocs CLI ships `agents-start-here` and `docs list/get` the same way.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: no loop, poll, timer, hook or launch. Each call is the existing shim start (one node, one pij-rs exec, as for `pij claim`) and an in-memory read of bytes in the binary; no file read, no daemon, no network. Scales with nothing: no per-seat or per-tick work.
- Pages are public-safe: no customer or person names.
